cookies.description:
Optional. Leave empty to transcribe public videos without signing in. Paste your own Instagram cookies in JSON format to also transcribe age-restricted videos and videos of private accounts your account follows. It is a secret input, so the Apify Console hides and encrypts it.

Format: [{"name":"sessionid","value":"...","domain":".instagram.com"}, ...]
cookies.title: Instagram Cookies (Optional)

includeSegments.description: When enabled, the output will include a 'segments' array with per-segment timestamps and text alongside the full transcript. Each segment represents a distinct phrase with start/end times in seconds. Note: enabling this feature incurs an additional charge per run.
includeSegments.title: Include Timestamped Segments

language.description: Language of the video audio. Leave empty for automatic detection. Only used when Whisper is active.
language.title: Language

maxPosts_per_username.description: How many of each username's newest posts to check (after the date and pinned-post filters below). Every video among them is transcribed (each video of a carousel on its own); a post without a video gets a record with the status not_a_video. Public profiles need no sign-in, however many posts you ask for; a private profile needs your cookies.
maxPosts_per_username.title: Max Posts Per Username

newerThan.description: Skip posts published before this date. Leave empty for no date filter. Must be a date from 2000-01-01 up to the day before the run. Applies to usernames only. The date is read from the post's id, so it can be off by up to a day.
newerThan.title: Only posts newer than

skipPinnedPosts.description: Leave out the posts a profile has pinned to the top of its grid. Applies to usernames only. A pinned post that is also the newest post cannot be recognised and stays in.
skipPinnedPosts.title: Skip pinned posts

transcriptionMethod.description: How to extract transcripts. 'auto' tries native Instagram captions first, then falls back to Whisper AI. 'native' only uses Instagram captions. 'whisper' always uses AI speech-to-text.
transcriptionMethod.title: Transcription Method

usernames.description: Usernames whose newest posts should be checked for videos. Each entry can be a username (with or without @) or a profile link such as https://www.instagram.com/natgeo/. Every video is transcribed (each video of a carousel on its own); a post without a video gets a record with the status not_a_video.
usernames.title: Instagram Usernames or Profile Links

videoUrls.description: List of Instagram video or reel URLs to transcribe. Supports /p/, /reel/, and /tv/ formats. Provide this, usernames, or both.
videoUrls.title: Instagram Video URLs

whisperModel.description: Whisper AI model size. Larger models are more accurate but use more memory and time. Only used when transcription method involves Whisper.
whisperModel.title: Whisper Model Size
